correctness.rationale: For full-dimensional simplex Δ, K_t=(1-t)Δ+t(-Δ), normalized mixed volume Q_{n,k}=V(K_t[n-k],-K_t[k])/vol(K_t). Orthant slicing gives F_n(a,b)=Σ binom(n,j)^2 a^(n-j)b^j. With a+b=1 and p=ab, H_n(p)=Σ n!p^j/[(n-2j)! j!²] has positive-factor product from simple zeros of Legendre P_n. The normalized reflected polynomial factors as (s+u)^n∏(1+r_i(p)su/(s+u)^2), r_i(p)=λ_i(1-4p)/(1+λ_i p) strictly decreasing. Every interior coefficient includes positive binom(n-2,k-1)e_1, hence strict decrease from binom(n,k) to 1 as t grows 0 to 1/2. Hypergeometric binomial-square second moment yields center quadratic 2k(n-k)/(2n-1). Verified by separate exact rational coefficient calculations for n=2..8.
